ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: H1 2026 and FY2025 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: earnings growth is -59.34 percent a year from FY2024 to FY2025, so a PEG is not defined: the ratio is only meaningful for POSITIVE earnings growth, and a PEG built on a zero or negative rate is a zero or negative number that is not a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
